title: ValidationAlgorithm
description: v1.0.0 — Meta-schema describing the BibleFi canonical validation pipeline. Defines the schema for validation algorithm configurations that can be applied to any ScriptureRecord or other BibleFi schema instance.

pipeline_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this validation pipeline configuration.

pipeline_version.description: Semantic version of this pipeline configuration (e.g. '1.0.0').

target_schema_id.description: The $id of the JSON Schema being validated by this pipeline (e.g. 'https://schemas.biblefi.io/v2.1/scripture_record.schema.json').

description.description: Human-readable description of this validation pipeline's purpose.

steps.description: Ordered list of validation steps. Steps are executed in array order unless depends_on_steps introduces a DAG ordering.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the pipeline (used in depends_on_steps references).

step_type.description: The type of validation operation to perform.

is_required.description: Whether this step is mandatory. If false, failures produce warnings only unless fail_action overrides.

fail_action.description: Action to take when this step fails.

config.description: Step-specific configuration. Schema is determined by step_type.

depends_on_steps.description: step_id values that must complete successfully before this step runs. Enables DAG-ordered execution.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time for this step in milliseconds.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step validates.

output_format.description: Format of the pipeline's validation output.

circuit_bindings.description: Bindings from ZK circuit identifiers to the pipeline steps that use them.

circuit_id.description: Identifier of the ZK circuit (matches zero_knowledge_proofs.circuit_id in ScriptureRecord).

step_id.description: The pipeline step_id of the zk_proof_verification step that uses this circuit.

verification_key_uri.description: URI from which the circuit verification key can be fetched.

proof_system.description: ZK proof system used by this circuit.

tags.description: Free-form tags for pipeline discovery and categorization.
